title: a build commit names its ticket in its subject
intention: The hollow reading counts a commit as this ticket's build only when the commit's SUBJECT names the ticket id; a body-only mention never moves the anchor. Named build_commits stays the escape.
why: Measured 2026-11-12: the hollow prediction for 96f71a89a0fa read its charters unseen. The anchor was 2cc799a6, because 0115dfff ('IOU scrub: ...', 2026-09-09) names 96f71a89a0fa only in its body and touched a charter in its writes_to. _build_commits (hollow.py:218) greps the whole message. Over 751 cast tickets, 117 carry a body-only mention and in 55 it precedes every subject mention; 54 of those 55 are passing mentions.
traces_to: Law 8 — the hollow reading must take away this build, not an older one a passing mention points at. Outline 9.4.2.3.2 (Hollow runs: proves a proof goes red when the build is removed).
how: _build_commits adds %s to its git log format and keeps a line only when the id is in its subject. A red-first proof over a scratch repo, one tooth per clause.

clauses.claim: a commit naming the ticket only in its body and changing a writes_to file does not move build_anchor before it
a commit naming the ticket in its subject and changing a writes_to file still anchors the build at its parent
a named build_commits sha whose subject names no id still anchors the build at its parent

decisions.text: D1: _build_commits formats '%H %cI %s' and keeps a commit only when tid is in its subject; the docstring says why (0115dfff, 96f71a89a0fa).
D2: the proof builds scratch repos as test_hollow_anchors_without_a_journaled_buildme.py does and calls build_anchor, one tooth per clause, PROVES keys 1-3; __main__ runs print_teeth_main.

measured.saw: 96f71a89a0fa anchored at 2cc799a6 by 0115dfff, a body-only mention; 55 of 751 tickets have a body-only mention before every subject mention
measured.how: git log -F --grep=96f71a89a0fa over the charters; a scratch census over every cast ticket's commits, split by subject and body

constraints.text: every component talks to every other only through its public interface; a ticket's proofs measure only that component
Nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass.

sought: where the build commits are found
how the named escape joins them

order.why_now: 96f71a89a0fa's hollow reading cannot seal until the anchor stands before its build

hypotheses.expect: the three teeth green and the sibling hollow proofs unchanged
hypotheses.falsifier: a body-only mention still moves the anchor, or a subject mention or a named sha stops anchoring

criteria.claim: the falsifier holds as named teeth

verdicts.claim: the falsifier holds as named teeth
verdicts.evidence: claimed pass by CC; the verdict door's own re-run of this instrument is the reading, recorded beside it as observed_runs
verdicts.discriminating_observation: bin/cairn test over the new proof: 3 teeth green twice; sibling anchor proofs (named build commits, before the build that stands, without a journaled BUILDME, instrument commits, moved file, repaired build) green; live: 96f71a89a0fa's build commits now begin at 1c153faf, 0115dfff no longer counted; hollow sealed
